column3: ("Agni and Soma are these two. How is hospitality made to Soma ... the oblation brought near.")
column4: ಅಗ್ನಿಶ್ಚ ವಾ ಏತೌ ಸೋಮಶ್ಚ ಕಥಾ ... ಸರ್ವಾ ದೇವತಾ ಜನಯತಿ (Sanskrit only, no translation)
column5: The English gives a full translation of the Taittirīya Saṃhitā quotation, which the Kannada prints only in Sanskrit with no English rendering.
